## 1. `data-stat` resolution

All keys resolve through `app.js`’s `statMap` to fields present in `data.js`.

| Attribute/key | Occurrences | `data.js` source | Runtime value | Result |

- EPM scenarios: `[1.00, 1.25, 1.50]`
- Eight model fallback cost/pass entries
- Escalation multipliers: `[0.4, 1.6, 10.1, 17.8, 28.3, 41.9, 68.7, 316.5]`

- Chart projection constants

became:

clCost = costs[costs.length - 1]
